subject: Later Swiftedge XRP perpetual order-book wall and depth observation

capture.note: The page was opened during the run. The provider's own last-updated time is retained; the retrieval tool did not expose an exact request time or original HTTP headers. This is a later page state than the 22:51 UTC search-result snapshot retained in the preceding artifact.

source.source_type: XRP perpetual futures order-book wall and estimated positioning dashboard
methodology_disclosed: Largest resting orders within 3% of price are grouped by $0.001.
Near-price depth is shown as a one-minute average.
The page says its order-book and positioning numbers are rebuilt every two minutes.
Positioning levels are estimates from part of the market's public positions.
The provider explicitly says resting walls are often pulled and the levels are not predictions.
limitations: No venue-by-venue constituents or raw exchange sequence/update IDs are exposed on the rendered page.
The page is an aggregated provider view, not an independently archived native exchange snapshot.
Resting limit orders can be cancelled before execution.
Positioning walls are estimates from part of the market's positions, not actual guaranteed liquidation prices.
Exact retrieval time and original HTTP response bytes were not captured.

comparison_to_prior_page_state.interpretation: The two-minute-later page state shows different displayed bid-wall placement and size. This does not prove orders were executed or cancelled; venue composition and order-book sequence data are not exposed.

depth_interpretation.within_1_percent: Displayed ask depth exceeds bid depth in this provider's one-minute aggregate.
depth_interpretation.within_2_percent: Displayed bid depth exceeds ask depth in this provider's one-minute aggregate.
depth_interpretation.conclusion: Near-price depth asymmetry changes with the selected band; a single wall or band does not establish directional support or resistance.

model_ineligibility_reasons: Provider aggregation is not a raw venue-by-venue depth feed.
No exact retrieval timestamp or raw HTTP receipt was captured.
Resting walls can be cancelled and are not executed liquidity.
Positioning estimates cover only part of the market's public positions.
Depth asymmetry reverses between the one-percent and two-percent bands.
No synchronized multi-venue snapshot or historical replenishment/cancellation series is available.
